The Best Black Friday deal is already live: AirPods Pro 3 at $100 off (Same price as entry-level AirPods)

The Day 7 Amazon Black Friday deals are now live with up to 50% off a range of premium brands in the Today’s Big Deal section, but the insane $100 price drop on Apple’s top-of-the-line AirPods Pro 3 deal is still live. This is easily one of the best Black Friday deals we have tracked yet, premium or otherwise.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – $100 off!
  • AirPods Max 2 $419 (Reg. $549) – Now even lower at $130 off
  • Beats 360 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones $249 (Reg. $349) – All-time low

Amazon is offering a deep $130 price drop on the 2026 AirPods Max 2 right now, but the real headliner here is AirPods Pro 3 at a whopping $100 off.

Yes, Apple did release all-new AirPods 5 this year in September, but for the uninitiated, those are the new entry-level AirPods, not the pro-grade set.

The AirPods 5 come in two flavors – the base set at $129 with ANC and the upgraded set at $149 with ANC and the Wireless Charging Case.

AirPods 5 are great buds, for sure, but are largely inferior to the flagship AirPods Pro 3 for all but those who prefer the more open-ear approach on Apple’s entry sets – AirPods Pro 3 deliver a 3x better noise-cancellation experience, better sound quality in my opinion, heart rate sensing built right in, a wireless charging case with a lanyard loop, and longer battery life, as well as a host of additional smart health features: Hearing Test, Hearing Aid, and Hearing Protection.
